turns: When will my last order arrive?

expected.rubric: PASS if the reply gives the order's estimated arrival as Sep 17 (or 'arriving by Sep 17'), matching the order record's estimated_delivery. FAIL if it states a different date, says the order has not shipped, or gives no date despite the record having one.

notes: Order #20458's line item is a real product (Dome Pendant, gid://shopify/ProductVariant/47643685748898); the order and its estimated_delivery are authored, since no live customer/order was reachable (see evals/fixtures.py). The order-grounding gate forced get_orders as the turn's first tool in all 3 live trials, as expected. skill_loaded: 'customer-care' was dropped after a first live run answered correctly (3/3) without loading it — a single get_orders call was enough that the model judged the skill's extra rules unnecessary; per the commerce-evals skill's authoring rule, an unexpected-but-correct route widens the case instead of being re-pinned.
